annotations.title: Redeem the claim and create the account

description: Redeem a claim once you have published one of its three proofs (a /.well-known file, a <meta> tag, or a DNS TXT record). On success it creates the account and the site and returns the tracking snippet to install. Idempotent — safe to retry. Requires the claim secret as a bearer token.
name: cromanion_verify_claim

snippet.description: Paste this before </body> on every page. Do not assemble your own.

provedBy.description: Which of the three proofs we actually read.

status.description: `created` the first time, `existing` on a retry — the same account either way.
